controles.web: Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to Yahweh’s law.
controles.kjv: Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the Lord.
controles.livre: Álefe :Bem-aventurados são os puros em seus caminhos, os que andam na lei do SENHOR.

controles.web: Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.
controles.kjv: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.
controles.livre: Bem-aventurados são os que guardam os testemunhos dele, e o buscam com todo o coração;

controles.web: Yes, they do nothing wrong. They walk in his ways.
controles.kjv: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.
controles.livre: E não praticam perversidade, mas andam nos caminhos dele.

controles.web: You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.
controles.kjv: Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently.
controles.livre: Tu mandaste que teus mandamentos fossem cuidadosamente obedecidos.

controles.web: Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!
controles.kjv: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!
controles.livre: Ah! Como gostaria que meus caminhos fossem dirigidos a guardar teus estatutos!

controles.web: Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.
controles.kjv: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.
controles.livre: Então não me envergonharia, quando eu observasse todos os teus mandamentos.

versos.hebraico: א֭וֹדְךָ בְּיֹ֣שֶׁר לֵבָ֑ב בְּ֝לָמְדִ֗י מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.
controles.kjv: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.
controles.livre: Louvarei a ti com um coração correto, enquanto aprendo os juízos de tua justiça.

controles.web: I will observe your statutes. Don’t utterly forsake me.
controles.kjv: I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.
controles.livre: Eu guardarei teus estatutos; não me abandones por completo.

controles.web: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.
controles.kjv: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.
controles.livre: Bete :Com que um rapaz purificará o seu caminho? Sendo obediente conforme a tua palavra.

controles.web: With my whole heart, I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.
controles.kjv: With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.
controles.livre: Eu te busco como todo o meu coração; não me deixes desviar de teus mandamentos.

versos.hebraico: בְּ֭לִבִּי צָפַ֣נְתִּי אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ לְ֝מַ֗עַן לֹ֣א אֶֽחֱטָא־לָֽךְ׃

controles.web: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
controles.kjv: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.
controles.livre: Guardei a tua palavra em meu coração, para eu não pecar contra ti.

controles.web: Blessed are you, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.
controles.kjv: Blessed art thou, O Lord: teach me thy statutes.
controles.livre: Bendito és tu, SENHOR; ensina-me teus estatutos.

controles.web: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.
controles.kjv: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.
controles.livre: Com meus lábios contei todos os juízos de minha boca.

controles.web: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.
controles.kjv: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.
controles.livre: Eu me alegro mais com o caminho de teus estatutos, do que com todas as riquezas.

controles.web: I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.
controles.kjv: I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.
controles.livre: Meditarei em teus mandamentos, e darei atenção a teus caminhos.

controles.web: I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word.
controles.kjv: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.
controles.livre: Terei prazer em teus estatutos; não me esquecerei de tua palavra.

controles.web: Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.
controles.kjv: Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live, and keep thy word.
controles.livre: Guímel :Trata bem o teu servo, para que eu viva, e obedeça tua palavra.

controles.web: Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.
controles.kjv: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.
controles.livre: Abre meus olhos, para que eu veja as maravilhas de tua lei.

versos.hebraico: גֵּ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י בָאָ֑רֶץ אַל־תַּסְתֵּ֥ר מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: I am a stranger on the earth. Don’t hide your commandments from me.
controles.kjv: I am a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.
controles.livre: Eu sou peregrino na terra, não escondas de mim os teus mandamentos.

controles.web: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.
controles.kjv: My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto thy judgments at all times.
controles.livre: Minha alma está despedaçada de tanto desejar os teus juízos em todo tempo.

controles.web: You have rebuked the proud who are cursed, who wander from your commandments.
controles.kjv: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from thy commandments.
controles.livre: Tu repreendes aos malditos arrogantes, que se desviam de teus mandamentos.

versos.hebraico: גַּ֣ל מֵֽ֭עָלַי חֶרְפָּ֣ה וָב֑וּז כִּ֖י עֵדֹתֶ֣יךָ נָצָֽרְתִּי׃

controles.web: Take reproach and contempt away from me, for I have kept your statutes.
controles.kjv: Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept thy testimonies.
controles.livre: Tira-me de minha humilhação e desprezo, pois eu guardei teus testemunhos.

versos.hebraico: גַּ֤ם יָֽשְׁב֣וּ שָׂ֭רִים בִּ֣י נִדְבָּ֑רוּ עַ֝בְדְּךָ֗ יָשִׂ֥יחַ בְּחֻקֶּֽיךָ׃

controles.web: Though princes sit and slander me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.
controles.kjv: Princes also did sit and speak against me: but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.
controles.livre: Até mesmo os príncipes se sentaram, e falaram contra mim; porém o teu servo estava meditando em teus estatutos.

controles.web: Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors.
controles.kjv: Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors.
controles.livre: Pois teus testemunhos são meus prazeres e meus conselheiros.

controles.web: My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!
controles.kjv: My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.
controles.livre: Dálete :Minha alma está grudada ao pó; vivifica-me conforme tua palavra.

controles.web: I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.
controles.kjv: I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes.
controles.livre: Eu te contei os meus caminhos, e tu me respondeste; ensina-me conforme teus estatutos.

controles.web: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.
controles.kjv: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.
controles.livre: Faze-me entender o caminho de teus preceitos, para eu falar de tuas maravilhas.

controles.web: My soul is weary with sorrow: strengthen me according to your word.
controles.kjv: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.
controles.livre: Minha alma se derrama de tristeza; levanta-me conforme tua palavra.

controles.web: Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously!
controles.kjv: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.
controles.livre: Desvia de mim o caminho de falsidade; e sê piedoso dando-me tua lei.

controles.web: I have chosen the way of truth. I have set your ordinances before me.
controles.kjv: I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid before me.
controles.livre: Eu escolhi o caminho da fidelidade; e pus diante de mim os teus juízos.

controles.web: I cling to your statutes, Yahweh. Don’t let me be disappointed.
controles.kjv: I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O Lord, put me not to shame.
controles.livre: Estou apegado a teus testemunhos; ó SENHOR, não me envergonhes.

controles.web: I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free.
controles.kjv: I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.
controles.livre: Correrei pelo caminho de teus mandamentos, porque tu alargaste o meu coração.

versos.hebraico: הוֹרֵ֣נִי יְ֭הוָה דֶּ֥רֶךְ חֻקֶּ֗יךָ וְאֶצְּרֶ֥נָּה עֵֽקֶב׃

controles.web: Teach me, Yahweh, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.
controles.kjv: Teach me, O Lord, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.
controles.livre: Hê :Ensina-me, SENHOR, o caminho de teus estatutos, e eu o guardarei até o fim.

controles.web: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.
controles.kjv: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.
controles.livre: Dá-me entendimento, e eu guardarei a tua lei, e a obedecerei de todo o meu coração.

controles.web: Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.
controles.kjv: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.
controles.livre: Faze-me andar na trilha de teus mandamentos, porque nela tenho prazer.

controles.web: Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain.
controles.kjv: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.
controles.livre: Inclina meu coração a teus testemunhos, e não à ganância.

versos.hebraico: הַעֲבֵ֣ר עֵ֭ינַי מֵרְא֣וֹת שָׁ֑וְא בִּדְרָכֶ֥ךָ חַיֵּֽנִי׃

controles.web: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.
controles.kjv: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; and quicken thou me in thy way.
controles.livre: Desvia meus olhos para que não olhem para coisas inúteis; vivifica-me pelo teu caminho.

controles.web: Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.
controles.kjv: Stablish thy word unto thy servant, who is devoted to thy fear.
controles.livre: Confirma tua promessa a teu servo, que tem temor a ti.

versos.hebraico: הַעֲבֵ֣ר חֶ֭רְפָּתִי אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָגֹ֑רְתִּי כִּ֖י מִשְׁפָּטֶ֣יךָ טוֹבִֽים׃

controles.web: Take away my disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good.
controles.kjv: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments are good.
controles.livre: Desvia de mim a humilhação que eu tenho medo, pois teus juízos são bons.

controles.web: Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness.
controles.kjv: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.
controles.livre: Eis que amo os teus mandamentos; vivifica-me por tua justiça.

controles.web: Let your loving kindness also come to me, Yahweh, your salvation, according to your word.
controles.kjv: Let thy mercies come also unto me, O Lord, even thy salvation, according to thy word.
controles.livre: Vau :E venham sobre mim tuas bondades, SENHOR; e também a tua salvação, segundo tua promessa.

controles.web: So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me, for I trust in your word.
controles.kjv: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in thy word.
controles.livre: Para que eu tenha resposta ao que me insulta; pois eu confio em tua palavra.

versos.hebraico: וְֽאַל־תַּצֵּ֬ל מִפִּ֣י דְבַר־אֱמֶ֣ת עַד־מְאֹ֑ד כִּ֖י לְמִשְׁפָּטֶ֣ךָ יִחָֽלְתִּי׃

controles.web: Don’t snatch the word of truth out of my mouth, for I put my hope in your ordinances.
controles.kjv: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in thy judgments.
controles.livre: E nunca tires de minha boca a palavra da verdade, pois eu espero em teus juízos.

controles.web: So I will obey your law continually, forever and ever.
controles.kjv: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.
controles.livre: Assim obedecerei a tua lei continuamente, para todo o sempre.

controles.web: I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.
controles.kjv: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.
controles.livre: E andarei livremente por longas distâncias, pois busquei teus preceitos.

versos.hebraico: וַאֲדַבְּרָ֣ה בְ֭עֵדֹתֶיךָ נֶ֥גֶד מְלָכִ֗ים וְלֹ֣א אֵבֽוֹשׁ׃

controles.web: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.
controles.kjv: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.
controles.livre: Também falarei de teus testemunhos perante reis, e não me envergonharei.

controles.web: I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them.
controles.kjv: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.
controles.livre: E terei prazer em teus mandamentos, que eu amo.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶשָּֽׂא־כַפַּ֗י אֶֽל־מִ֭צְוֺתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָהָ֗בְתִּי וְאָשִׂ֥יחָה בְחֻקֶּֽיךָ׃

controles.web: I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes.
controles.kjv: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes.
controles.livre: E levantarei as minhas mãos a teus mandamentos, que eu amo; e meditarei em teus estatutos.

controles.web: Remember your word to your servant, because you gave me hope.
controles.kjv: Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.
controles.livre: Záin :Lembra-te da palavra dada a teu servo, à qual mantenho esperança.

versos.hebraico: זֹ֣את נֶחָמָתִ֣י בְעָנְיִ֑י כִּ֖י אִמְרָתְךָ֣ חִיָּֽתְנִי׃

controles.web: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.
controles.kjv: This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.
controles.livre: Isto é meu consolo na minha aflição, porque tua promessa me vivifica.

versos.hebraico: זֵ֭דִים הֱלִיצֻ֣נִי עַד־מְאֹ֑ד מִ֝תּֽוֹרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א נָטִֽיתִי׃

controles.web: The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don’t swerve from your law.
controles.kjv: The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet have I not declined from thy law.
controles.livre: Os arrogantes têm zombado de mim demasiadamente; porém não me desviei de tua lei.

controles.web: I remember your ordinances of old, Yahweh, and have comforted myself.
controles.kjv: I remembered thy judgments of old, O Lord; and have comforted myself.
controles.livre: Eu me lembrei de teus juízos muito antigos, SENHOR; e assim me consolei.

controles.web: Indignation has taken hold on me, because of the wicked who forsake your law.
controles.kjv: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.
controles.livre: Eu me enchi de ira por causa dos perversos, que abandonam tua lei.

controles.web: Your statutes have been my songs, in the house where I live.
controles.kjv: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.
controles.livre: Teus estatutos foram meus cânticos no lugar de minhas peregrinações.

versos.hebraico: זָ֘כַ֤רְתִּי בַלַּ֣יְלָה שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהוָ֑ה וָֽ֝אֶשְׁמְרָ֗ה תּוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: I have remembered your name, Yahweh, in the night, and I obey your law.
controles.kjv: I have remembered thy name, O Lord, in the night, and have kept thy law.
controles.livre: De noite tenho me lembrado de teu nome, SENHOR; e tenho guardado tua lei.

controles.web: This is my way, that I keep your precepts.
controles.kjv: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.
controles.livre: Isto eu tenho feito, porque guardo teus mandamentos.

controles.web: Yahweh is my portion. I promised to obey your words.
controles.kjv: Thou art my portion, O Lord: I have said that I would keep thy words.
controles.livre: Hete :O SENHOR é minha porção; eu disse que guardaria tuas palavras.

controles.web: I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.
controles.kjv: I intreated thy favour with my whole heart: be merciful unto me according to thy word.
controles.livre: Busquei a tua face com todo o meu coração; tem piedade de mim segundo tua palavra.

controles.web: I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.
controles.kjv: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.
controles.livre: Eu dei atenção a meus caminhos, e dirigi meus pés a teus testemunhos.

controles.web: I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.
controles.kjv: I made haste, and delayed not to keep thy commandments.
controles.livre: Eu me apressei, e não demorei a guardar os teus mandamentos.

versos.hebraico: חֶבְלֵ֣י רְשָׁעִ֣ים עִוְּדֻ֑נִי תּֽ֝וֹרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃

controles.web: The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won’t forget your law.
controles.kjv: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten thy law.
controles.livre: Bandos de perversos me roubaram; porém não me esqueci de tua lei.

versos.hebraico: חֲצֽוֹת־לַ֗יְלָה אָ֭קוּם לְהוֹד֣וֹת לָ֑ךְ עַ֝֗ל מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.
controles.kjv: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments.
controles.livre: No meio da noite eu me levanto para te louvar, por causa dos juízos de tua justiça.

versos.hebraico: חָבֵ֣ר אָ֭נִי לְכָל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְרֵא֑וּךָ וּ֝לְשֹׁמְרֵ֗י פִּקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: I am a friend of all those who fear you, of those who observe your precepts.
controles.kjv: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.
controles.livre: Sou companheiro de todos os que te temem, e dos que guardam os teus mandamentos.

versos.hebraico: חַסְדְּךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה מָלְאָ֥ה הָאָ֗רֶץ חֻקֶּ֥יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי׃

controles.web: The earth is full of your loving kindness, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.
controles.kjv: The earth, O Lord, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.
controles.livre: A terra está cheia de tua bondade, SENHOR; ensina-me os teus estatutos.

controles.web: Do good to your servant, according to your word, Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O Lord, according unto thy word.
controles.livre: Tete :Tu fizeste bem a teu servo, SENHOR, conforme tua palavra.

versos.hebraico: ט֤וּב טַ֣עַם וָדַ֣עַת לַמְּדֵ֑נִי כִּ֖י בְמִצְוֺתֶ֣יךָ הֶאֱמָֽנְתִּי׃

controles.web: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.
controles.kjv: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.
controles.livre: Ensina-me bom senso e conhecimento, pois tenho crido em teus mandamentos.

versos.hebraico: טֶ֣רֶם אֶ֭עֱנֶה אֲנִ֣י שֹׁגֵ֑ג וְ֝עַתָּ֗ה אִמְרָתְךָ֥ שָׁמָֽרְתִּי׃

controles.web: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I observe your word.
controles.kjv: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word.
controles.livre: Antes de ter sido afligido, eu andava errado; mas agora guardo tua palavra.

controles.web: You are good, and do good. Teach me your statutes.
controles.kjv: Thou art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.
controles.livre: Tu és bom, e fazes o bem; ensina-me os teus estatutos.

versos.hebraico: טָפְל֬וּ עָלַ֣י שֶׁ֣קֶר זֵדִ֑ים אֲ֝נִ֗י בְּכָל־לֵ֤ב׀ אֱצֹּ֬ר פִּקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts.
controles.kjv: The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart.
controles.livre: Os arrogantes forjaram mentiras contra mim; mas eu com todo o meu coração guardo os teus mandamentos.

versos.hebraico: טָפַ֣שׁ כַּחֵ֣לֶב לִבָּ֑ם אֲ֝נִ֗י תּוֹרָתְךָ֥ שִֽׁעֲשָֽׁעְתִּי׃

controles.web: Their heart is as callous as the fat, but I delight in your law.
controles.kjv: Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in thy law.
controles.livre: O coração deles se incha como gordura; mas eu tenho prazer em tua lei.

controles.web: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.
controles.kjv: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.
controles.livre: Foi bom pra mim ter sido afligido, para assim eu aprender os teus estatutos.

controles.web: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
controles.kjv: The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.
controles.livre: Melhor para mim é a lei de tua boca, do que milhares de peças de ouro ou prata.

versos.hebraico: יָדֶ֣יךָ עָ֭שׂוּנִי וַֽיְכוֹנְנ֑וּנִי הֲ֝בִינֵ֗נִי וְאֶלְמְדָ֥ה מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: Your hands have made me and formed me. Give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.
controles.kjv: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.
controles.livre: Iode :Tuas mãos me fizeram e me formaram; faze-me ter entendimento, para que eu aprenda teus mandamentos.

versos.hebraico: יְ֭רֵאֶיךָ יִרְא֣וּנִי וְיִשְׂמָ֑חוּ כִּ֖י לִדְבָרְךָ֣ יִחָֽלְתִּי׃

controles.web: Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.
controles.kjv: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word.
controles.livre: Os que te temem olham para mim e se alegram, porque eu mantive esperança em tua palavra.

versos.hebraico: יָדַ֣עְתִּי יְ֭הוָה כִּי־צֶ֣דֶק מִשְׁפָּטֶ֑יךָ וֶ֝אֱמוּנָ֗ה עִנִּיתָֽנִי׃

controles.web: Yahweh, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.
controles.kjv: I know, O Lord, that thy judgments are right, and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.
controles.livre: Eu sei, SENHOR, que teus juízos são justos; e que tu me afligiste por tua fidelidade.

controles.web: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.
controles.kjv: Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.
controles.livre: Seja agora tua bondade para me consolar, segundo a promessa que fizeste a teu servo.

controles.web: Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.
controles.kjv: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for thy law is my delight.
controles.livre: Venham tuas misericórdias sobre mim, para que eu viva; pois tua lei é o meu prazer.

versos.hebraico: יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ זֵ֭דִים כִּי־שֶׁ֣קֶר עִוְּת֑וּנִי אֲ֝נִ֗י אָשִׂ֥יחַ בְּפִקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully. I will meditate on your precepts.
controles.kjv: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in thy precepts.
controles.livre: Sejam envergonhados os arrogantes, porque eles me prejudicaram com mentiras; porém eu medito em teus mandamentos.

controles.web: Let those who fear you turn to me. They will know your statutes.
controles.kjv: Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that have known thy testimonies.
controles.livre: Virem-se a mim os que te temem e conhecem os teus testemunhos.

versos.hebraico: יְהִֽי־לִבִּ֣י תָמִ֣ים בְּחֻקֶּ֑יךָ לְ֝מַ֗עַן לֹ֣א אֵבֽוֹשׁ׃

controles.web: Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed.
controles.kjv: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.
controles.livre: Seja meu coração correto em teus estatutos, para eu não ser envergonhado.

controles.web: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.
controles.kjv: My soul fainteth for thy salvation: but I hope in thy word.
controles.livre: Cafe :Minha alma desfalece por tua salvação; em tua palavra mantenho esperança.

versos.hebraico: כָּל֣וּ עֵ֭ינַי לְאִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ לֵ֝אמֹ֗ר מָתַ֥י תְּֽנַחֲמֵֽנִי׃

controles.web: My eyes fail for your word. I say, “When will you comfort me?”
controles.kjv: Mine eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?
controles.livre: Meus olhos desfaleceram por tua promessa, enquanto eu dizia: Quando tu me consolarás?

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־הָ֭יִיתִי כְּנֹ֣אד בְּקִיט֑וֹר חֻ֝קֶּ֗יךָ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃

controles.web: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke. I don’t forget your statutes.
controles.kjv: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet do I not forget thy statutes.
controles.livre: Porque fiquei como um odre na fumaça, porém não me esqueci teus testemunhos.

versos.hebraico: כַּמָּ֥ה יְמֵֽי־עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ מָתַ֬י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בְרֹדְפַ֣י מִשְׁפָּֽט׃

controles.web: How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me?
controles.kjv: How many are the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?
controles.livre: Quantos serão os dias de teu servo? Quando farás julgamento aos meus perseguidores?

versos.hebraico: כָּֽרוּ־לִ֣י זֵדִ֣ים שִׁיח֑וֹת אֲ֝שֶׁ֗ר לֹ֣א כְתוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: The proud have dug pits for me, contrary to your law.
controles.kjv: The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after thy law.
controles.livre: Os arrogantes me cavaram covas, aqueles que não são conforme a tua lei.

controles.web: All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!
controles.kjv: All thy commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.
controles.livre: Todos os teus mandamentos são verdade; com mentiras me perseguem; ajuda-me.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֭מְעַט כִּלּ֣וּנִי בָאָ֑רֶץ וַ֝אֲנִ֗י לֹא־עָזַ֥בְתִּי פִקֻּודֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: They had almost wiped me from the earth, but I didn’t forsake your precepts.
controles.kjv: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.
controles.livre: Estou quase que destruído por completo sobre a terra; porém eu não deixei teus mandamentos.

controles.web: Preserve my life according to your loving kindness, so I will obey the statutes of your mouth.
controles.kjv: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.
controles.livre: Vivifica-me conforme tua bondade, então guardarei o testemunho de tua boca.

controles.web: Yahweh, your word is settled in heaven forever.
controles.kjv: For ever, O Lord, thy word is settled in heaven.
controles.livre: Lâmede :Para sempre, SENHOR, tua palavra permanece nos céus.

versos.hebraico: לְדֹ֣ר וָ֭דֹר אֱמֽוּנָתֶ֑ךָ כּוֹנַ֥נְתָּ אֶ֝֗רֶץ וַֽתַּעֲמֹֽד׃

controles.web: Your faithfulness is to all generations. You have established the earth, and it remains.
controles.kjv: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.
controles.livre: Tua fidelidade dura de geração em geração; tu firmaste a terra, e assim ela permanece.

versos.hebraico: לְֽ֭מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ עָמְד֣וּ הַיּ֑וֹם כִּ֖י הַכֹּ֣ל עֲבָדֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: Your laws remain to this day, for all things serve you.
controles.kjv: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all are thy servants.
controles.livre: Elas continuam por tuas ordens até hoje, porque todos são teus servos.

versos.hebraico: לוּלֵ֣י ת֭וֹרָתְךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָ֑י אָ֝֗ז אָבַ֥דְתִּי בְעָנְיִֽי׃

controles.web: Unless your law had been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.
controles.kjv: Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.
controles.livre: Se a tua lei não fosse meu prazer, eu já teria perecido em minha aflição.

versos.hebraico: לְ֭עוֹלָם לֹא־אֶשְׁכַּ֣ח פִּקּוּדֶ֑יךָ כִּ֥י בָ֝֗ם חִיִּיתָֽנִי׃

controles.web: I will never forget your precepts, for with them, you have revived me.
controles.kjv: I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.
controles.livre: Nunca esquecerei de teus mandamentos, porque tu me vivificaste por eles.

controles.web: I am yours. Save me, for I have sought your precepts.
controles.kjv: I am thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.
controles.livre: Eu sou teu, salva-me, porque busquei teus preceitos.

versos.hebraico: לִ֤י קִוּ֣וּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים לְאַבְּדֵ֑נִי עֵ֝דֹתֶ֗יךָ אֶתְבּוֹנָֽן׃

controles.web: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me. I will consider your statutes.
controles.kjv: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider thy testimonies.
controles.livre: Os perversos me esperaram, para me destruírem; porém eu dou atenção a teus testemunhos.

versos.hebraico: לְֽכָל תִּ֭כְלָה רָאִ֣יתִי קֵ֑ץ רְחָבָ֖ה מִצְוָתְךָ֣ מְאֹֽד׃

controles.web: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commands are boundless.
controles.kjv: I have seen an end of all perfection: but thy commandment is exceeding broad.
controles.livre: A toda perfeição eu vi fim; mas teu mandamento é extremamente grande.

controles.web: How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.
controles.kjv: O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.
controles.livre: Mem :Ah, como eu amo a tua lei! O dia todo eu medito nela.

versos.hebraico: מֵ֭אֹ֣יְבַי תְּחַכְּמֵ֣נִי מִצְוֺתֶ֑ךָ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם הִיא־לִֽי׃

controles.web: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.
controles.kjv: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they are ever with me.
controles.livre: Ela me faz mais sábio do que meus inimigos por meio de teus mandamentos, porque ela está sempre comigo.

versos.hebraico: מִכָּל־מְלַמְּדַ֥י הִשְׂכַּ֑לְתִּי כִּ֥י עֵ֝דְוֺתֶ֗יךָ שִׂ֣יחָה לִֽֿי׃

controles.web: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation.
controles.kjv: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies are my meditation.
controles.livre: Sou mais inteligente que todos os meus instrutores, porque medito em teus testemunhos.

controles.web: I understand more than the aged, because I have kept your precepts.
controles.kjv: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.
controles.livre: Sou mais prudente que os anciãos, porque guardei teus mandamentos.

versos.hebraico: מִכָּל־אֹ֣רַח רָ֭ע כָּלִ֣אתִי רַגְלָ֑י לְ֝מַ֗עַן אֶשְׁמֹ֥ר דְּבָרֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word.
controles.kjv: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.
controles.livre: Afastei meus pés de todo mau caminho, para guardar tua palavra.

controles.web: I have not turned aside from your ordinances, for you have taught me.
controles.kjv: I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.
controles.livre: Não me desviei de teus juízos, porque tu me ensinaste.

controles.web: How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!
controles.kjv: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
controles.livre: Como são doces tuas palavras ao meu paladar! Mais que o mel em minha boca.

versos.hebraico: מִפִּקּוּדֶ֥יךָ אֶתְבּוֹנָ֑ן עַל־כֵּ֝֗ן שָׂנֵ֤אתִי׀ כָּל־אֹ֬רַח שָֽׁקֶר׃

controles.web: Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way.
controles.kjv: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.
controles.livre: Obtenho conhecimento por meio de teus preceitos; por isso odeio todo caminho de mentira.

controles.web: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
controles.kjv: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
controles.livre: Nun :Tua palavra é lâmpada para meus pés e luz para meu caminho.

controles.web: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.
controles.kjv: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.
controles.livre: Eu jurei, e assim cumprirei, de guardar os juízos de tua justiça.

controles.web: I am afflicted very much. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your word.
controles.kjv: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O Lord, according unto thy word.
controles.livre: Eu estou muito aflito, SENHOR; vivifica-me conforme a tua palavra.

versos.hebraico: נִדְב֣וֹת פִּ֭י רְצֵה־נָ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּֽמִשְׁפָּטֶ֥יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי׃

controles.web: Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth. Yahweh, teach me your ordinances.
controles.kjv: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O Lord, and teach me thy judgments.
controles.livre: Agrada-te das ofertas voluntárias de minha boca, SENHOR; e ensina-me teus juízos.

versos.hebraico: נַפְשִׁ֣י בְכַפִּ֣י תָמִ֑יד וְ֝תֽוֹרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃

controles.web: My soul is continually in my hand, yet I won’t forget your law.
controles.kjv: My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.
controles.livre: Continuamente arrisco minha alma, porém não me esqueço de tua lei.

versos.hebraico: נָתְנ֬וּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים פַּ֣ח לִ֑י וּ֝מִפִּקּוּדֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א תָעִֽיתִי׃

controles.web: The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven’t gone astray from your precepts.
controles.kjv: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.
controles.livre: Os perversos me armaram um laço de armadilha, mas não me desviei de teus mandamentos.

versos.hebraico: נָחַ֣לְתִּי עֵדְוֺתֶ֣יךָ לְעוֹלָ֑ם כִּֽי־שְׂשׂ֖וֹן לִבִּ֣י הֵֽמָּה׃

controles.web: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
controles.kjv: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.
controles.livre: Tomei teus testemunhos por herança para sempre, pois eles são a alegria de meu coração.

versos.hebraico: נָטִ֣יתִי לִ֭בִּי לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת חֻקֶּ֗יךָ לְעוֹלָ֥ם עֵֽקֶב׃

controles.web: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end.
controles.kjv: I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, even unto the end.
controles.livre: Inclinei meu coração para praticar os teus testemunhos para todo o sempre.

controles.web: I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.
controles.kjv: I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.
controles.livre: Sâmeque :Odeio os inconstantes, mas amo a tua lei.

controles.web: You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.
controles.kjv: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.
controles.livre: Tu és meu refúgio e meu escudo; eu espero em tua palavra.

controles.web: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.
controles.kjv: Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.
controles.livre: Afastai-vos de mim, malfeitores, para que eu guarde os mandamentos de meu Deus.

controles.web: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.
controles.kjv: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.
controles.livre: Sustenta-me conforme a tua promessa, para que eu viva; e não me faças ser humilhado em minha esperança.

controles.web: Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.
controles.kjv: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.
controles.livre: Segura-me, e estarei protegido; então continuamente pensarei em teus estatutos.

controles.web: You reject all those who stray from your statutes, for their deceit is in vain.
controles.kjv: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.
controles.livre: Tu atropelas a todos que se desviam de teus estatutos; pois o engano deles é mentira.

versos.hebraico: סִגִ֗ים הִשְׁבַּ֥תָּ כָל־רִשְׁעֵי־אָ֑רֶץ לָ֝כֵ֗ן אָהַ֥בְתִּי עֵדֹתֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross. Therefore I love your testimonies.
controles.kjv: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.
controles.livre: Tu tiras a todos os perversos da terra como se fossem lixo; por isso eu amo teus testemunhos.

controles.web: My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments.
controles.kjv: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.
controles.livre: Meu corpo se arrepia de medo de ti; e temo os teus juízos.

controles.web: I have done what is just and righteous. Don’t leave me to my oppressors.
controles.kjv: I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.
controles.livre: Áin :Eu fiz juízo e justiça; não me abandones com os meus opressores.

controles.web: Ensure your servant’s well-being. Don’t let the proud oppress me.
controles.kjv: Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.
controles.livre: Sê tu a garantia do bem de teu servo; não me deixes ser oprimido pelos arrogantes.

controles.web: My eyes fail looking for your salvation, for your righteous word.
controles.kjv: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.
controles.livre: Meus olhos desfaleceram de esperar por tua salvação, e pela palavra de tua justiça.

controles.web: Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness. Teach me your statutes.
controles.kjv: Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.
controles.livre: Age para com teu servo segundo tua bondade, e ensina-me teus estatutos.

controles.web: I am your servant. Give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.
controles.kjv: I am thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.
controles.livre: Eu sou teu servo. Dá-me entendimento; então conhecerei teus testemunhos.

controles.web: It is time to act, Yahweh, for they break your law.
controles.kjv: It is time for thee, Lord, to work: for they have made void thy law.
controles.livre: É tempo do SENHOR agir, porque estão violando tua lei.

controles.web: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.
controles.kjv: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.
controles.livre: Por isso eu amo teus mandamentos mais que o ouro, o mais fino ouro.

versos.hebraico: עַל־כֵּ֤ן׀ כָּל־פִּקּ֣וּדֵי כֹ֣ל יִשָּׁ֑רְתִּי כָּל־אֹ֖רַח שֶׁ֣קֶר שָׂנֵֽאתִי׃

controles.web: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way.
controles.kjv: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way.
controles.livre: Por isso considero corretos todos os teus mandamentos quanto a tudo, e odeio todo caminho de falsidade.

controles.web: Your testimonies are wonderful, therefore my soul keeps them.
controles.kjv: Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.
controles.livre: Pê :Maravilhosos são teus testemunhos, por isso minha alma os guarda.

controles.web: The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.
controles.kjv: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.
controles.livre: A entrada de tuas palavras dá luz, dando entendimento aos simples.

controles.web: I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments.
controles.kjv: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.
controles.livre: Abri minha boca, e respirei; porque desejei teus mandamentos.

controles.web: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.
controles.kjv: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.
controles.livre: Olha-me, e tem piedade de mim; conforme teu costume para com os que amam o teu nome.

controles.web: Establish my footsteps in your word. Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.
controles.kjv: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
controles.livre: Firma meus passos em tua palavra, e que nenhuma perversidade me domine.

controles.web: Redeem me from the oppression of man, so I will observe your precepts.
controles.kjv: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.
controles.livre: Resgata-me da opressão dos homens; então guardarei teus mandamentos.

controles.web: Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.
controles.kjv: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.
controles.livre: Brilha teu rosto sobre teu servo, e ensina-me teus estatutos.

versos.hebraico: פַּלְגֵי־מַ֭יִם יָרְד֣וּ עֵינָ֑י עַ֝֗ל לֹא־שָׁמְר֥וּ תוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: Streams of tears run down my eyes, because they don’t observe your law.
controles.kjv: Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.
controles.livre: Ribeiros d'água descem de meus olhos, porque eles não guardam tua lei.

controles.web: You are righteous, Yahweh. Your judgments are upright.
controles.kjv: Righteous art thou, O Lord, and upright are thy judgments.
controles.livre: Tsadê :Tu és justo, SENHOR; e corretos são teus juízos.

controles.web: You have commanded your statutes in righteousness. They are fully trustworthy.
controles.kjv: Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful.
controles.livre: Tu ensinaste teus testemunhos justos e muito fiéis.

controles.web: My zeal wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words.
controles.kjv: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.
controles.livre: Meu zelo me consumiu, porque meus adversários se esqueceram de tuas palavras.

controles.web: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.
controles.kjv: Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.
controles.livre: Refinada é a tua palavra, e teu servo a ama.

versos.hebraico: צָעִ֣יר אָנֹכִ֣י וְנִבְזֶ֑ה פִּ֝קֻּדֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃

controles.web: I am small and despised. I don’t forget your precepts.
controles.kjv: I am small and despised: yet do not I forget thy precepts.
controles.livre: Eu sou pequeno e desprezado; porém não me esqueço de teus mandamentos.

controles.web: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness. Your law is truth.
controles.kjv: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.
controles.livre: Tua justiça é justa para sempre, e tua lei é verdade.

controles.web: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.
controles.kjv: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet thy commandments are my delights.
controles.livre: Aperto e angústia me encontraram; ainda assim teus mandamentos são meus prazeres.

controles.web: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live.
controles.kjv: The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.
controles.livre: A justiça de teus testemunhos dura para sempre; dá-me entendimento, e então viverei.

versos.hebraico: קָרָ֣אתִי בְכָל־לֵ֭ב עֲנֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֗ה חֻקֶּ֥יךָ אֶצֹּֽרָה׃

controles.web: I have called with my whole heart. Answer me, Yahweh! I will keep your statutes.
controles.kjv: I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O Lord: I will keep thy statutes.
controles.livre: Cofe :Clamei com todo o meu coração; responde-me, SENHOR; guardarei teus estatutos.

controles.web: I have called to you. Save me! I will obey your statutes.
controles.kjv: I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.
controles.livre: Clamei a ti; salva-me, e então guardarei os teus testemunhos.

controles.web: I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.
controles.kjv: I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.
controles.livre: Eu me antecedi ao amanhecer, e gritei; e mantive esperança em tua palavra.

controles.web: My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.
controles.kjv: Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.
controles.livre: Meus olhos antecederam as vigílias da noite, para meditar em tua palavra.

versos.hebraico: ק֭וֹלִי שִׁמְעָ֣ה כְחַסְדֶּ֑ךָ יְ֝הוָ֗ה כְּֽמִשְׁפָּטֶ֥ךָ חַיֵּֽנִי׃

controles.web: Hear my voice according to your loving kindness. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your ordinances.
controles.kjv: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O Lord, quicken me according to thy judgment.
controles.livre: Ouve minha voz, segundo tua bondade, SENHOR; vivifica-me conforme teu juízo.

controles.web: They draw near who follow after wickedness. They are far from your law.
controles.kjv: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.
controles.livre: Aproximam-se de mim os que praticam maldade; eles estão longe de tua lei.

controles.web: You are near, Yahweh. All your commandments are truth.
controles.kjv: Thou art near, O Lord; and all thy commandments are truth.
controles.livre: Porém tu, SENHOR, estás perto de mim ; e todos os teus mandamentos são verdade.

versos.hebraico: קֶ֣דֶם יָ֭דַעְתִּי מֵעֵדֹתֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם יְסַדְתָּֽם׃

controles.web: Of old I have known from your testimonies, that you have founded them forever.
controles.kjv: Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.
controles.livre: Desde antigamente eu soube de teus testemunhos, que tu os fundaste para sempre.

controles.web: Consider my affliction, and deliver me, for I don’t forget your law.
controles.kjv: Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.
controles.livre: Rexe :Olha a minha aflição, e livra-me dela ; pois não me esqueci de tua lei.

controles.web: Plead my cause, and redeem me! Revive me according to your promise.
controles.kjv: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.
controles.livre: Defende minha causa, e resgata-me; vivifica-me conforme tua palavra.

versos.hebraico: רָח֣וֹק מֵרְשָׁעִ֣ים יְשׁוּעָ֑ה כִּֽי־חֻ֝קֶּיךָ לֹ֣א דָרָֽשׁוּ׃

controles.web: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they don’t seek your statutes.
controles.kjv: Salvation is far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.
controles.livre: A salvação está longe dos perversos, porque eles não buscam teus estatutos.

controles.web: Great are your tender mercies, Yahweh. Revive me according to your ordinances.
controles.kjv: Great are thy tender mercies, O Lord: quicken me according to thy judgments.
controles.livre: Muitas são tuas misericórdias, SENHOR; vivifica-me conforme teus juízos.

versos.hebraico: רַ֭בִּים רֹדְפַ֣י וְצָרָ֑י מֵ֝עֵדְוֺתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א נָטִֽיתִי׃

controles.web: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries. I haven’t swerved from your testimonies.
controles.kjv: Many are my persecutors and mine enemies; yet do I not decline from thy testimonies.
controles.livre: Muitos são meus perseguidores e meus adversários; porém eu não me desvio de teus testemunhos.

versos.hebraico: רָאִ֣יתִי בֹ֭גְדִים וָֽאֶתְקוֹטָ֑טָה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִ֝מְרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁמָֽרוּ׃

controles.web: I look at the faithless with loathing, because they don’t observe your word.
controles.kjv: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.
controles.livre: Eu vi aos enganadores e os detestei, porque eles não guardam tua palavra.

versos.hebraico: רְ֭אֵה כִּי־פִקּוּדֶ֣יךָ אָהָ֑בְתִּי יְ֝הוָ֗ה כְּֽחַסְדְּךָ֥ חַיֵּֽנִי׃

controles.web: Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your loving kindness.
controles.kjv: Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O Lord, according to thy lovingkindness.
controles.livre: Vê, SENHOR, que eu amo teus mandamentos; vivifica-me conforme a tua bondade.

controles.web: All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever.
controles.kjv: Thy word is true from the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever.
controles.livre: O princípio de tua palavra é fiel, e o juízo de tua justiça dura para sempre.

versos.hebraico: שָׂ֭רִים רְדָפ֣וּנִי חִנָּ֑ם ומדבריך פָּחַ֥ד לִבִּֽי׃

controles.web: Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.
controles.kjv: Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.
controles.livre: Xin :Príncipes me perseguiram sem causa, mas meu coração temeu a tua palavra.

versos.hebraico: שָׂ֣שׂ אָ֭נֹכִֽי עַל־אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ כְּ֝מוֹצֵ֗א שָׁלָ֥ל רָֽב׃

controles.web: I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.
controles.kjv: I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.
controles.livre: Eu me alegro em tua palavra, tal como alguém que encontra um grande tesouro.

controles.web: I hate and abhor falsehood. I love your law.
controles.kjv: I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.
controles.livre: Odeio e abomino a falsidade; mas amo a tua lei.

versos.hebraico: שֶׁ֣בַע בַּ֭יּוֹם הִלַּלְתִּ֑יךָ עַ֝֗ל מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: Seven times a day, I praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.
controles.kjv: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.
controles.livre: Louvo a ti sete vezes ao dia, por causa dos juízos de tua justiça.

versos.hebraico: שָׁל֣וֹם רָ֭ב לְאֹהֲבֵ֣י תוֹרָתֶ֑ךָ וְאֵֽין־לָ֥מוֹ מִכְשֽׁוֹל׃

controles.web: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.
controles.kjv: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.
controles.livre: Muita paz têm aqueles que amam a tua lei; e para eles não há tropeço.

controles.web: I have hoped for your salvation, Yahweh. I have done your commandments.
controles.kjv: Lord, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.
controles.livre: Espero por tua salvação, SENHOR; e pratico teus mandamentos.

controles.web: My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.
controles.kjv: My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.
controles.livre: Minha alma guarda teus testemunhos, e eu os amo muito.

versos.hebraico: שָׁמַ֣רְתִּי פִ֭קּוּדֶיךָ וְעֵדֹתֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י כָל־דְּרָכַ֣י נֶגְדֶּֽךָ׃

controles.web: I have obeyed your precepts and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you.
controles.kjv: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways are before thee.
controles.livre: Eu guardo teus preceitos e teus testemunhos, porque todos os meus caminhos estão diante de ti.

versos.hebraico: תִּקְרַ֤ב רִנָּתִ֣י לְפָנֶ֣יךָ יְהוָ֑ה כִּדְבָרְךָ֥ הֲבִינֵֽנִי׃

controles.web: Let my cry come before you, Yahweh. Give me understanding according to your word.
controles.kjv: Let my cry come near before thee, O Lord: give me understanding according to thy word.
controles.livre: Tau :Chegue meu clamor perante teu rosto, SENHOR; dá-me entendimento conforme tua palavra.

controles.web: Let my supplication come before you. Deliver me according to your word.
controles.kjv: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.
controles.livre: Venha minha súplica diante de ti; livra-me conforme tua promessa.

versos.hebraico: תַּבַּ֣עְנָה שְׂפָתַ֣י תְּהִלָּ֑ה כִּ֖י תְלַמְּדֵ֣נִי חֻקֶּֽיךָ׃

controles.web: Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.
controles.kjv: My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.
controles.livre: Meus lábios falarão muitos louvores, pois tu me ensinas teus estatutos.

versos.hebraico: תַּ֣עַן לְ֭שׁוֹנִי אִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ כִּ֖י כָל־מִצְוֺתֶ֣יךָ צֶּֽדֶק׃

controles.web: Let my tongue sing of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness.
controles.kjv: My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments are righteousness.
controles.livre: Minha língua falará de tua palavra, porque todos os teus mandamentos são justiça.

controles.web: Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.
controles.kjv: Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.
controles.livre: Que tua mão me socorra, porque escolhi seguir teus preceitos.

controles.web: I have longed for your salvation, Yahweh. Your law is my delight.
controles.kjv: I have longed for thy salvation, O Lord; and thy law is my delight.
controles.livre: Desejo tua salvação, SENHOR; e tua lei é o meu prazer.

controles.web: Let my soul live, that I may praise you. Let your ordinances help me.
controles.kjv: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.
controles.livre: Que minha alma viva e louve a ti; e que teus juízos me socorram.

versos.hebraico: תָּעִ֗יתִי כְּשֶׂ֣ה אֹ֭בֵד בַּקֵּ֣שׁ עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י מִ֝צְוֺתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃

controles.web: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.
controles.kjv: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.
controles.livre: Tenho andado sem rumo, como uma ovelha perdida; busca a teu servo, pois eu não me esqueci de teus mandamentos.
